name: Riverside U-Pick Berries and Pumpkins
description: Riverside U-Pick Berries and Pumpkins grows Strawberries and Pumpkins in Phoenix, NY. The farm is independent, and its seasons run through spring and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
